_meta.provenance: Ethereum-labelled exchange accounts (non-deposit, non-contract) carried over because one key controls one address on every EVM chain, plus explorer-tagged wallets from dawsbot/eth-labels @ 14247ba8cf and brianleect/etherscan-labels @ 923aba72. Built by backend/scripts/port_evm_labels.py.
_meta.verification_note: Every address has no contract code on Arbitrum One and has sent at least one transaction there (nonce > 0), which only its key holder can do. Re-check on the explorer before evidentiary use.
_meta.audit_2026_11_05: 5 Nov 2026 security audit: removed labels that name a router, a DEX, another company's treasury or a contract deployer rather than a cash-out wallet (an exchange match ends a trace). OKX DEX Router 2 and 4 moved to router_labels.json.
_meta.india_exchanges: 4 Indian exchange wallets added from data/india_exchanges.json (14 and 15 Nov 2026), which records each one's public source (an explorer's public name tag, or a wallet list the exchange published itself) and what was left out and why.

por_2026_11_15.rule: scripts/import_por_labels.py: each exchange's own proof-of-reserves wallet list (a first-party source, accepted by the owner 15 Nov 2026); a conflict with any other file, a demo or the label store is left out, never overwritten; a token contract or an address with no activity on this chain is left out

Bybit.note: October 2026 file (Last-Modified 27 Oct 2026); the November file was not yet published on 14 Nov. The archived copy is byte-identical (same SHA-256).

OKX.note: November 2026 file (okx_por_2026110100_V1.csv inside; Last-Modified 1 Nov 2026), the latest on the download page on 14 Nov. Each row carries OKX's signature of 'I am an OKX address'; the signatures were not verified here. OKX lists no BNB Smart Chain wallets. Rows typed other than 'Non Staking' (staking positions) are not read.
